fullSource:
#!/usr/bin/env ghul

use default

let words = if args.count > 0 then args else ["one", "two", "three"] fi
for (position, word) in words |> index() do
    write_line("arg {position}: {word}")
od
output:
arg 0: one
arg 1: two
arg 2: three
